_comment: slug -> where github-repo-sync.py finds repo/stack/deploy data. slug must match the vault projects/*.md frontmatter 'project:' key (same join key as the vault sync path). owner_repo: GitHub API. local_git_dir: a bare/working repo reachable by `git --git-dir=<path> log` directly from elitedesk (no GitHub involved). unsupported: no remote (or no .git at all) — github-repo-sync.py records repo_meta={source:'github-api', unsupported: <reason>} and moves on, it does not error.

justmeandguitars._note: vault slug covers two nested repos (overlay-app + planning); overlay-app is primary since it's the shippable Next.js piece

stano._note: bare repo already on elitedesk itself, not GitHub — confirmed 2026-07-16 via `ssh uwh git -C ~/Stano remote -v`; working copy moved to ~/code/stano on 2026-08-03
